jobs.title: Project Manager Offshore Subsea Cables
jobs.description:
Your Work Context

Jan De Nul Group offers specialised services for the installation of submarine structures for the oil, gas and renewable energy markets. Seabed preparation, trench dredging, and their stabilisation and ballasting are part of these offshore services. Whether it concerns subsea pipelines, cables, umbilicals, foundations, platforms or even entire wind farms: always tailored to the customer and, if desired, on an EPC basis. Do you want to be part of our international team?

Your Role

As Project Manager you are responsible for an offshore project by organising and supervising the execution of the works. You ensure that they are executed as described in the contract.

- Together with the engineering team you are responsible for choosing the most economical, safe and successful method to carry out the project.

- You preside over meetings with clients, authorities and other contractors on site.

- You are responsible for the site administration, cost controlling and budgeting.

- You coordinate the project team. In this, you also coach the employees and you are responsible for their development and evaluation.

- You communicate with clients and third parties on a daily basis.

- During the works, you report to the head office every day.

- You have the final responsibility for compliance with the legal regulations regarding safety, environment and quality on site.

- You plan the deployment of personnel, vessels, auxiliary equipment and subcontractors.

What do you need to have?

You have an engineering degree and at least 10 years' experience in the sector. You are a born leader and very persuasive. You're great at planning and organising, always bearing in mind the client's wishes and needs. You speak and write fluent English.

Working at Jan De Nul

Working at Jan De Nul means helping to find solutions to some of the biggest challenges of our time: from energy transition to rising sea levels to smart mobility. It means learning and working together every day, with the aim of ensuring the global quality of life for generations to come.

What We Offer

- An ongoing training programme through our JDN Academy.

- The opportunity to exercise at work through our FIT programme.

- A permanent contract with 42 paid holidays (20 statutory, 12 ADV and 10 public holidays).

- A healthy work-life balance (flexible working hours and occasional work from home).

- A competitive salary with thirteenth month and double holiday pay, including:

- Meal vouchers and eco vouchers

- Company car including fuel card or charging pass in Belgium.

- Opportunity to participate in bicycle leasing,

- Group and hospitalisation insurance

- Option of iPhone with data subscription

- Various staff discounts

- applicable with Belgian contract.

The world becomes what you make of itJan De Nul is shaping water and land worldwide. We drive the transition to renewable energy with offshore energy infrastructure. We focus on nature-inclusive dredging solutions to build ports and protect our coastline. We develop innovative construction projects for smart mobility and sustainable buildings. And we redevelop our planet by giving polluted sites a new purpose. At Jan De Nul, the world becomes what you make of it.

Jan De Nul Group promotes diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We are an equal opportunities and anti-discrimination employer.

jobs.title: Service Delivery Manager - SAP
jobs.description:
Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Bij Credendo speelt het SAP-landschap een cruciale rol in onze bedrijfsprocessen. Als Service Delivery Manager voor SAP ben je verantwoordelijk voor het end-to-end beheer van de SAP-applicaties en de bijhorende diensten. - Ervaring met ITIL-processen (incident-, problem-, change- en release management) is een must; ITIL-certificering is een troef.

- Je bent communicatief sterk en kan zowel met technische teams als met business stakeholders schakelen.

- Je hebt een analytische geest en bent resultaatgericht.

- Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid en denkt proactief na over optimalisaties en automatisering.

- Kennis van security- en compliancevereisten (ISO 20000, ISO 27001, DORA) is een pluspunt.

- Ervaring met SAP platformen in Microsoft Azure-omgevingen is een troef.

- Maaltijdcheques

jobs.title: Industrial Project Manager
jobs.description:
As an INDUSTRIAL PROJECT MANAGER, you lead different kind of Industrial Projects with multi-disciplinary, multi-site and remote teams. You master project manager behaviors like: Identifying and organizing resources needed to accomplish tasks, consistently achieving project goals, taking responsibility for actions and projects goals, Initiating and generating activities, persuading and influencing, gaining clear agreement and commitment from others. Is experienced with industrial program management; setup, realize and monitor the Industrial segment roadmap with regards to cost & capacity together with the various stakeholders (e.g. Asia sites, Marketing, logistics etc.). Applies structure also in ‘green field’ situations. Has a broaden business scope and acts on it.

Typical Industrial Projects / Activities

- During a NPI from Project Initiation to Entitlement. Up to the Release gate part of the NPI core team. Leading, driving and owning the industrialization activities and requirement as defined in the Industrial Manufacturing Strategy. These activities typically relate to sourcing (e.g. FE / BE multi sourcing), BE factory flow (assembly & test), FE / BE interaction improvements (e.g. saw lane reduction), and package development. Furthermore, preparing the volume ramp up ensuring customers stakes and hassle-free ramp up after R-gate, develop a clear VRU-plan with allocated resources to ensure Safe Launch & Entitlement requirements, gate passing criteria and have a clear agreement with the NPI-project manager in case of post R-gate activities.

- Volume ramp-up, leading the NPI after R-gate to Entitlement, VRU. Typically, this includes ensuring customer deliveries; safe launch for diffusion, assembly, test, non-production test removal; and test stage reductions, yield improvements and multi-site increase.

- Multi- sourcing: diffusion and back-end (assembly and test) process fab transfer projects.

jobs.title: Project Manager – Laser-Driven Radiation Source (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Focused Energy is a laser-driven fusion company building technologies that can unlock clean, abundant energy. Alongside our long-term mission, we also develop near-term, high-impact applications based on compact laser-driven radiation sources that combine MeV X-rays and fast neutrons in a single system for non-destructive testing and advanced inspection.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Project Manager to lead the execution of the worlds first laser-driven radiation source prototype, bringing together multiple subsystem owners and engineering teams to deliver a research-operable prototype. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys turning complex technical development into a structured plan, enabling teams to deliver on time, and building an operational hardware system.

You will work together with the main system owners within the project make sure the right work happens at the right time, with clear interfaces, controlled changes, and strong transparency.

Key Responsibilities

- Own the integrated project plan: maintain the master schedule across subsystems, dependencies, and critical path; drive recovery plans when milestones slip.

- Lead project governance and cadence: run core meetings, maintain decisions and actions, and ensure consistent status reporting that highlights progress, blockers, and next steps.

- Align work to the technical roadmap: ensure subsystem plans and milestones stay consistent with the program direction; surface deviations early and drive resolution.

- Drive requirements and interface management: Ensure system-level requirements and interfaces are tracked, implemented and validated consistently and are under change control.

- Decision traceability: Establish a way with the team to efficiently document progress and make decisions traceable.

- Own risk and issue management: maintain a single risk register process with mitigation ownership, regular review cadence, and clear escalation paths. Steer and track the risk reduction over time to meet the project goals.

- Budget & procurement coordination: track budget, forecasts, and changes; coordinate long-lead procurement tracking with engineering and system owners.

- Verification & readiness: plan and guide readiness reviews with system owners (e.g., design reviews, integration readiness, commissioning readiness); ensure evidence, test plans, and acceptance criteria are captured.

- Safety & operational readiness: ensure a research-operable safety approach is implemented (hazard reviews, procedures, training, operational envelopes) so the system is safe for researchers to use.

- Process improvement: continuously improve delivery flow and documentation efficiency with the Project Management Office to reduce redundancy and increase execution speed, without compromising safety or quality.

Required Skills & Experience

- Experience: 7+ years project/program management in complex R&D environments (hardware-heavy systems preferred: laser facilities, accelerators, aerospace, semiconductor tools, scientific infrastructure, robotics, or similar).

- Technical Background: Understand how the system components interact and have the ability to understand the technical problems the team faces on a high level. Have at least worked 3+ years in the technical execution besides your management experience.

- Planning discipline: strong ability to build and maintain integrated plans (milestones, work packages, dependencies, critical path) and keep teams aligned.

- Risk & change control: proven experience running risk registers, issue management, and practical change control in dynamic R&D settings.

- Communication: clear, concise communicator who can lead meetings, write crisp status updates, and drive action closure with senior stakeholders.

- Operational rigor: able to support readiness/commissioning planning and ensure documentation and evidence are produced at a level that enables repeatable operation.

Nice-to-Have

- Experience managing first-of-a-kind builds, prototypes, or pilot facilities.

- Familiarity with review gates (PDR/CDR/TRR or equivalent) and verification planning.

- Exposure to safety-critical environments (high voltage, radiation-adjacent facilities, vacuum/laser labs, interlock systems).

- Experience working with cross-site teams and external suppliers.

Why Join Us:

- Mission-driven work on a technology stack at the intersection of physics, engineering, and real-world impact.

- High ownership and visibility in a fast-moving, cross-disciplinary team.

- Competitive compensation and participation in the company’s success (equity/ownership opportunities may be available depending on role and location).

- A collaborative, international environment with strong learning and growth opportunities.

- Flexible working model (role-dependent) and modern equipment and benefits.

What we offer

- Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

- Career Development: We invest in our people. Join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

- Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

- Your Success is Our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success.

- Vacation: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

- Flexibility: We offer a hybrid setup, giving you the freedom to work from our office while also enjoying the flexibility to work from home up to two days a week.

- Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a subsidized canteen.

- Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 15% on top of your monthly contributions.

- Equipment: Choose between a state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptop, fully equipped from day one.

- Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture.

- Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs whether it’s public transportation, taxis or car-sharing.

- Fitness with Wellhub: Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Role Description As a Project Manager for the Insurance Sector at Sollers Consulting, you will oversee the delivery of technology and business transformation projects for insurance clients. You will coordinate project plans, manage timelines, budgets, and resources, and ensure effective communication among stakeholders from both business and IT teams. Daily responsibilities include leading meetings, monitoring project progress, managing risks and issues, and preparing clear status reports for clients and internal stakeholders. You will work closely with international teams, aligning project scope with client expectations and supporting decision-making based on industry best practices. This is a full-time, hybrid role based in Poznań, with a mix of on-site collaboration and the flexibility to work from home.
Qualifications

- Strong project management skills, including experience in Project Management and Expediting activities to keep project deliverables on track.

- Experience in coordinating Expeditor and Expediting functions to manage vendor performance, material availability, and timely delivery.

- Knowledge of Inspection processes to support quality assurance, compliance, and acceptance of project outputs.

- Background in Logistics Management to coordinate resources, schedules, and dependencies across multiple teams and locations.

- Experience managing projects within the insurance or financial services sector, ideally involving core or front-end system implementations.

- Ability to work in an international, cross-functional environment, with strong stakeholder management and communication skills in English.

- Proven ability to analyze requirements, manage risks, and support change management and process improvement initiatives.

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, IT, Engineering, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum) are an advantage.

Project Manager, Meeting Management

Ben jij een organisatietalent dat energie krijgt van het coördineren van meetings en events? Dan hebben wij de uitdaging voor jou. Als Project Manager ben jij de schakel tussen onze klanten en (interne) partners. Je bent onder meer verantwoordelijk voor het zoeken naar de juiste locatie, het onderhandelen over tarieven en voorwaarden, het afsluiten van contracten en het beheren van budgetten. Afhankelijk van het project kun je daarnaast ook verantwoordelijk zijn voor deelnemersregistratie, het ontwikkelen van websites (op ons eigen platform) en ga je incidenteel mee on-site om ervoor te zorgen dat alles op locatie soepel verloopt.

We zoeken iemand die hoogwaardige ondersteuning biedt bij meetings, het overzicht bewaart en meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd succesvol weet te managen. Klinkt dit als jouw volgende stap? Lees dan verder.

Je hebt de regie over het volledige traject van meetings en events, van aanvraag en locatie-selectie tot uitvoering en evaluatie.

Je zoekt de meest geschikte hotels en locaties op basis van de wensen van de klant

Je onderhandelt offertes van leveranciers voor de beste tarieven en voorwaarden

Je bewaakt het budget en houdt grip op alle kosten

Je rapporteert in onze interne systemen op meeting informatie en budget

Je neemt deel aan events die georganiseerd worden door onze partners

Je initieert procesverbeteringen die aansluiten bij de strategie van het bedrijf

Je gebruikt je creativiteit om het event voor de klant tot een succes te maken

Wat goed is om te weten:

Onze projecten variëren van kleine bijeenkomsten met 10 tot grotere evenementen met 500 deelnemers

De communicatie binnen ons team is open, flexibel en transparant

Jij bent de expert voor onze klanten en verantwoordelijk voor het volgen van alle processen

We werken voornamelijk vanuit huis, maar we komen elke week samen op ons hoofdkantoor in Utrecht

Wat neem je mee:

Een Bachelor diploma of vergelijkbare ervaring met een zakelijke focus

Ervaring in meeting- of eventmanagement in een internationale of corporate omgeving.

Algemene kennis van bestemmingen, hotels en leveranciers is een must

Uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels

Ervaring met Office 365

Kennis van Cvent is een plus

Jij bent:

Uitstekend in het balanceren van meerdere prioriteiten

Georganiseerd, efficiënt en precies, met een scherp oog voor detail

Sterk in het opbouwen en onderhouden van zakelijke relaties

Een expert in het vinden van je weg in diverse (online) systemen

Besluitvaardig en proactief

In staat om je aan te passen aan veranderingen

Wat wij bieden:

Een open en informele cultuur gericht op doelen waarbij jouw geluk en carrièregroei voorop staan

De salarisrange voor deze functie ligt tussen de 38.000 en 50.000 euro bruto per jaar. Het uiteindelijke salaris hangt af van je kwalificaties, vaardigheden en ervaring.

Klinkt dit als jouw volgende stap? Solliciteer vandaag nog en maak impact.

Project Manager, Meeting Management

Weekly team day at the Utrecht office, other days flexible working from home

Are you an organised professional who thrives on coordinating meetings and events? Then this could be the opportunity for you. As Project Manager, you will act as the link between our clients and internal partners. Your responsibilities will include sourcing the right venue, negotiating rates and terms, contracting, and managing budgets. Depending on the project, you may also be responsible for attendee registration, website development (on our in-house platform), and occasionally providing onsite support to ensure everything runs smoothly.

We are looking for someone who can deliver high-quality meeting support, maintain a clear overview, and manage multiple projects at the same time. If this sounds like your next career move, read on.

As a Project Manager you will:

Source hotel/venue availability based on the program specifications

Utilize and leverage Client preferred hotel agreements when negotiating hotel contracts

Ensure supplier quotations are fully negotiated to secure the best possible rates and conditions

Manage external vendors and suppliers – for sourcing, negotiating, contracting and event delivery

Financial responsibility of the event budget – from budget preparation to final reconciliation

Participate in events organized by our partners

Track and report hotel room nights, spending, and cost savings

Ensure the integrity of technology-related data

Initiate process improvements that align with the client’s strategies and long-term goals

Programs will vary in scopes and size, ranging from 10 to 500 attendees

Communication within the team is open and flexible

You will be responsible for adhering to all processes and serving as your client’s subject matter expert

The role is home-based, but the team meets once a week at our head office in Utrecht

What we are looking for:

BA preferred or similar level of experience with a business focus

Experience in meetings management, understanding of meeting types and considerations

General knowledge of destinations, hotels, and suppliers

Excellent oral and written communication skills in both Dutch and English

Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365

Knowledge of Cvent is a plus

You are good at:

Effective time management and balancing multiple priorities

Being organized, efficient, accurate with attention to detail

Being proactive

Effective communication with colleagues and vendors

Managing event budgets and maintaining financial accuracy

Building relationships

A purpose-driven culture where we are committed to your happiness and career growth

Competitive salary

The salary range for the role is between 38.000 euro and 50.000 euro gross per year. The actual pay will depends on your qualifications, skills and experience.

Ready for your next career move? Apply today and make a real impact.

THE PERKS

Room to Grow

Our line of work and business structure challenge our people in a way that inspires growth, with learning and development built into every role. We give individuals ownership over the direction and speed in which they grow.

We’ve got you covered

Our extensive benefits include comprehensive healthcare, retirement plans, continued education support, diverse work locations, travel and hotel discounts, volunteer and sustainability opportunities and a successful employee recognition program.

We’re positive. You’ll love it.

Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure. For over 50 years, Thales has been a trusted partner of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. As a local industrial partner, Thales provides advanced solutions in Defence, Public Security, Civil Aviation, Space, Enterprise, and Cybersecurity across four sites throughout the country. Actively contribute hands-on to technical tasks, including troubleshooting complex issues, participating in code reviews, optimizing infrastructure, and improving system reliability. Work directly with engineers to design and implement scalable, high-availability solutions, leveraging industry best practices. You will ensure traffic boosting and service usage of managed services by collaborating with the Account/Marketing team. You will be the owner of project financial management, respecting the management approved margins Qualification Education, Experience, Knowledge and Skills To succeed at this job, you must have: experience with overseeing project scope and requirements, SLAs, change and customer relationship management, project handovers and ITIL foundation, practitioner, service manager and practitioner release and control certifications. You must be fluent in English and Arabic. We would like someone to join our team who has strong communication and stakeholder management skills. You must have a Degree in Computer, Electrical or Telecommunications Engineering or a related field. We are looking for someone with 10+ years of experience in software and services delivery, including at least 3 years of experience managing engineering teams of at least 5 team members. Hands-on experience with key technologies such as Public Cloud Operations (preferred GCP), Linux Administration, Application Support, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes/Docker. You must have experience in project budgeting and financials management. At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!

jobs.title: Compensation & Benefits Project Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.

Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

Job Description

SUMMARY OF POSITION AND OBJECTIVES:

The Compensation & Benefits Project Manager will support the Manager of the Compensation & Benefits Team with the execution, coordination, administration and continuous improvement of global compensation and benefits processes.

In this role, you will focus on ensuring the timely delivery of annual compensation cycles, incentive plans, reporting, analytics, governance and HR systems projects across an international environment.

POSITION & OBJECTIVES:

Key Responsibilities

Deputy to Manager of the Compensation & Benefits Team

-
Act as the operational partner and trusted Deputy to the Manager of the Compensation & Benefits Team.

-
Support prioritisation and execution of strategic initiatives.

-
Coordinate cross-functional activities involving HR and Finance staff, and Eurofins company leaders.

-
Ensure commitments are delivered on time and to a high standard.

-
Take ownership of recurring operational responsibilities.

-
Support key guidance document review cycles and updates in accordance with business priorities.

Annual Compensation Review Coordination

-
Coordinate the annual compensation and bonus review process for staff at the local corporate office.

-
Manage timelines, milestones, communications and deliverables.

-
Ensure data quality, consistency and compliance throughout the process.

-
Produce dashboards, reports and management presentations.

-
Monitor progress and proactively identify risks and delays.

-
Drive the completion of actions across multiple stakeholders and functions.

Compensation Analytics & Reporting

-
Consolidate and analyse large volumes of HR and financial data.

-
Develop KPIs, reports, dashboards and executive summaries.

-
Support decision-making through data-driven insights.

-
Perform recurring analyses related to compensation, bonuses and workforce trends.

-
Ensure accuracy, reliability and consistency of data.

Project Management & Process Excellence

-
Lead and coordinate compensation-related projects.

-
Improve, document and standardise processes.

-
Develop efficient workflows, templates and operational procedures.

-
Ensure strong governance and follow-up on deliverables.

-
Drive continuous improvement and automation initiatives.

-
Receive and process feedback from stakeholders to support continuous improvement.

Long-Term Incentive (LTI) Administration

-
Coordinate administration of long-term incentive plans.

-
Liaise with external providers and internal stakeholders.

-
Ensure smooth execution, controls and participant communications.

-
Support the preparation of analyses and materials for senior management.

Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Human Resources, Engineering or a related field.

Experience

The ideal candidate has a background in Finance, Controlling, Consulting, Project Management, HR Operations or Business Analytics. Success in this role will depend far more on execution capabilities, project management discipline, analytical strength, ownership and the ability to deliver complex recurring processes on time, rather than on prior Compensation & Benefits expertise. We are looking for a highly driven individual who takes accountability, follows through on commitments and can take on the role of a reliable Deputy to the Manager of Compensation & Benefits Team.

In addition, the ideal candidate has:

-
Approximately 5+ years of professional experience.

-
Experience in Finance, Controlling, Consulting, HR Operations, Project Management, Business Analytics or similar analytical functions.

-
Experience managing complex processes involving multiple stakeholders, while exposure to international environments and compensation processes and/or HRIS management being considered a plus.

-
Project management & deadline discipline, with an affinity for continuous improvement and process optimisation.

-
Analytical skills and strong attention to detail, with a key focus on ownership & accountability.

Additional Information

What’s in for you?

-
A unique opportunity to gain experience within a fast‑growing, international organisation.

-
Exposure to a wide range of corporate departments, providing a comprehensive understanding of how a global organisation operates.

You will join an international office ideally located near parks and green spaces, bringing together colleagues from over 35 nationalities. Additionally, we offer an attractive compensation package and extra-legal benefits that include covered transportation costs, organic meals, sports activities, and annual office events.

Location: Brussels, Belgium. Curious about where you’ll be working? Tour the office: Meet the office - Brussels, Belgium.

-

We support your development! Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

We embrace diversity! As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Eurofins network of companies believes in strength and innovation through diversity. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

Sustainability matters to us! We are well on our way to achieving our objective of carbon neutrality by 2025, through a combination of emission reduction and compensation initiatives. We encourage our laboratory leaders to make sustainable changes at their local level, and in addition to their initiatives we count on our dedicated carbon reduction team to help us to achieve this goal!

Find out more on our Careers page: https://careers.eurofins.com/

Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 60 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.95 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

jobs.title: Program Manager Workday (Freelance)
jobs.description:
Bij Cegeka geloven we in samenwerken: met onze klanten, met onze teams en met elkaar. Met dit project zetten we diezelfde ambitie om in een toekomstgerichte transformatie voor onze eigen organisatie. Vanaf september 2026 starten we met de gefaseerde implementatie van Workday binnen de volledige Cegeka groep. Samen met een externe implementatiepartner rollen we een businesskritisch platform uit dat de volledige employee lifecycle zal ondersteunen voor meer dan 8.000 collega’s in meer dan 15 landen. Voor dit strategische programma zoeken we een ervaren Program Manager Workday die de regie in handen neemt, interne stakeholders verbindt en ervoor zorgt dat deze complexe internationale implementatie succesvol wordt gerealiseerd. Dit is een interne sleutelrol binnen Cegeka, gericht op onze eigen organisatie en transformatie – niet op consultancyprojecten bij klanten maar wel om Cegeka nog sterker te maken voor onze klanten.

- Als Program Manager draag je de verantwoordelijkheid voor het volledige Workday-programma, van de voorbereiding en implementatie tot een succesvolle ingebruikname en duurzame verankering binnen de organisatie.

- Workday wordt een strategisch platform voor de volledige groep. Je zorgt ervoor dat de configuraties nauw aansluiten met de noden van onze business. Daarom zorg je ervoor dat business stakeholders, HR, IT en Finance gedurende het volledige traject betrokken blijven en eigenaarschap opnemen binnen de afgesproken scope, timing en budgetten.

- Aansturen van de externe Workday-implementatiepartner en fungeren als belangrijkste aanspreekpunt voor governance, escalaties, mijlpalen en contractuele afspraken.

- Bewaken van scope, kwaliteit, budget, risico’s, afhankelijkheden en timing over alle projectfases heen.

- Detecteren van kritische afhankelijkheden en risico’s voordat ze een impact hebben op het programma.

- Creëren van alignment tussen stakeholders verspreid over verschillende landen en business units.

- Coördineren van de interne HR-, IT- en Finance-workstreams en nauwe samenwerking en sturing van de Workday HR Expert en IT Functional Analyst die het programma ondersteunen.

- Aansturen van change management- en communicatie-initiatieven om adoptie binnen de organisatie te stimuleren.

- Garanderen van datakwaliteit en migratiegereedheid bij iedere faseovergang, je krijgt hierbij ondersteuning van de Workday HR Expert.

- Rapporteren over programmavoortgang, financiële resultaten, risico’s en planning aan senior stakeholders waaronder de CHRO, CIO en Executive Teams

- Zorg dragen voor een succesvolle overdracht naar de operationele organisatie, zodat Workday eind 2028 volledig ingebed, gedocumenteerd en gedragen wordt door Cegeka.

Wat breng jij mee?

- Een bewezen trackrecord in het leiden van grootschalige Workday-implementaties of vergelijkbare HCM-transformatieprogramma’s als Program Manager of Senior Project Manager.

- Ervaring met het aansturen van externe implementatiepartners, waarbij je de juiste balans vindt tussen samenwerking en het behouden van controle aan klantzijde.

- Kennis van internationale HR-transformatieprogramma’s binnen complexe, multi country omgevingen

- Sterke vaardigheden in stakeholdermanagement en het verbinden van uiteenlopende belangen over landen, afdelingen en managementniveaus heen.

- Het vermogen om structuur, duidelijkheid en focus te brengen in complexe programma’s met veel afhankelijkheden.

- Ervaring met programmasturing, budgetbeheer, governance, risicomanagement en change management.

- Een resultaatgerichte aanpak met oog voor kwaliteit, timing en succesvolle adoptie.

- Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in het Engels

Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?

- Je komt terecht bij een echte Top Employer

- Cegeka bewijst jaar na jaar in het Whitelane Research dat we een betrouwbare en toonaangevende partner zijn op vlak van IT-dienstverlening, met een eerste plaats in 2026 voor Security Services (vierde jaar op rij), een gedeelde tweede plaats voor Cloud & Infrastructure Services en Network & Connectivity

- We vragen heel wat (talenten) van jou. Gelukkig krijg je er ook heel wat voor terug! Competenties en karakter zijn voor ons essentieel, naast ervaring en ambities. Cegeka investeert voortdurend in talent management opdat alle medewerkers hun potentieel kunnen realiseren

- Wij hanteren een framework met het oog op eerlijke verloning, waarbij medewerkers worden verloond op basis van hun functie, ervaring en prestaties, onafhankelijk van gender of andere niet-werkgerelateerde kenmerken. Een elektrische wagen met laadpas of een mobiliteitsbudget, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, een interessante groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering, een gsm-abonnement, een forfaitaire onkostenvergoeding, een krachtige laptop en de mogelijkheid om je salarispakket een eigen accent te geven dankzij ons Flex Reward Plan

- Flexibele werkuren én een mooie work/life balans

- Een top team: waarin nieuwe frisse ideeën en initiatieven steeds welkom zijn! Team-events, happy hours en een steeds legendarisch bedrijfsfeest horen daar ook bij

- Continu bijleren: knowledge sharing meetings, deelname aan conferenties en externe opleidingen. Kennisdeling en bijleren staan centraal! Afhankelijk van je eigen interesses en initiatieven, biedt Cegeka verschillende horizontale en verticale carrièrepaden

- We hechten waarde aan duurzaamheid door CO2-neutraliteit na te streven met de elektrificatie van ons wagenpark en een milieuvriendelijk datacenter. We ontwikkelen innovatieve oplossingen met een positieve impact op milieu, mens en maatschappij, en streven naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen gewaardeerd en gehoord wordt.

- Wil jij instappen als freelancer? Geen probleem! Dan bieden wij jou een marktconform dagtarief en tal van voordelen aan.

Onze voordelen

Marktconform salaris met aantrekkelijke extralegale voordelen.

Continuous learning via hackathons, leesgroepen, events,...

Flexibele werktijden voor een betere balans tussen werk en privé.

Carrièregroei met horizontale en verticale ontwikkelpaden.

Hybride werkmodel dat efficiënt kantoor- en thuiswerk combineert.

Persoonlijke begeleiding door managers, coaches en sparringpartners.

ESG: lagere emissies, bevorderen van inclusie en duurzaamheid in IT.

Cegeka draagt met trots het Top Employer-certificaat.

Teamevenementen, happy hours, sport en grandioos bedrijfsfeest.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
About This Vacancy

Our client is seeking an experienced Program Manager to lead high-impact innovation and acceleration programs focused on deep-tech, dual-use technologies, and defense-related innovation.

You will manage complex European and international programs bringing together technology companies, industry experts, institutional stakeholders, and innovation ecosystem partners. The role requires strong program management capabilities, stakeholder coordination, and financial oversight to ensure successful program delivery.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead international innovation programs from planning through execution and reporting.

- Coordinate internal experts, external partners, subcontractors, and European consortium members.

- Manage deliverables, timelines, budgets, resources, and contractual commitments.

- Act as the key operational interface between stakeholders, partners, sponsors, and participating companies.

- Identify risks and implement mitigation plans to ensure program success.

- Oversee workshops, training sessions, bootcamps, networking events, and innovation challenges across Europe.

- Ensure compliance with program requirements and quality standards.

- Contribute to process improvement and operational excellence.

- Support the identification of new funding, partnership, and business opportunities.

What We Expect From You

- Proven experience managing complex projects or programs in a technology-driven environment.

- Strong background in program governance, planning, budgeting, reporting, and risk management.

- Experience working with international stakeholders, consortiums, or publicly funded projects.

- Ability to influence and coordinate teams without direct hierarchical authority.

- Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

- Comfortable operating in fast-paced and multicultural environments.

- Interest in deep-tech, innovation, aerospace, security, defense, or dual-use technologies is a strong asset.

- Fluent in English; French is a strong advantage.

- Proficiency with project management tools, Excel, and PowerPoint.

- Familiarity with European funding programs and reporting frameworks is a plus.

What You Can Expect From Us

TMC is an international high-tech consultancy company that brings expertise to its clients in order to support them with the realization of their technological challenges. As such, TMC is operating as an expert center at the disposition of its clients and we help them to be more competitive in an ever more global and faster-changing technological world. At TMC we believe that people are the driving force behind technological innovation. That is why we want to create the best possible conditions for tech talents to thrive in. We offer you a challenging and stimulating work environment in which you can be the director of your own career. As an Employeneur you are part of our TMC family. Next to our outstanding technical expertise, fun and engagement are meaningful parts of our culture.

jobs.title: GIS & BIM Project Manager Assistant – Milano
jobs.description:
Chi siamo?

Fondata nel 1997, One Team è un’azienda italiana solida e in forte crescita che lavora nell’ambito dei sistemi informativi a supporto dell’ingegneria e della produzione. L’azienda è tra i principali partner italiani dei maggiori brand globali di software per la progettazione ed è impegnata nel fornire soluzioni innovative ai propri clienti. One Team partecipa inoltre a progetti di sviluppo e innovazione europei. L’azienda lavora su tutto il territorio nazionale e si sta espandendo all’estero: ad oggi contiamo cinque sedi in Italia e una in Spagna. Il team è composto da oltre cento risorse, tra cui specialisti di prodotto, ingegneri, architetti, sistemisti, analisti programmatori e sviluppatori.

DESCRIZIONE

Per il potenziamento della Divisione GIS, BIM Infrastructure e Sviluppo Strategico siamo alla ricerca di una figura junior con forte attitudine tecnico-gestionale, desiderosa di crescere in un contesto dinamico e innovativo. La risorsa affiancherà la Responsabile di Settore e l’Area Manager nella gestione e nello sviluppo delle commesse GIS e BIM dedicate ai clienti pubblici e privati.

La figura ricoprirà un ruolo trasversale tra aspetti tecnici, organizzativi e di relazione con il cliente, contribuendo alla corretta pianificazione, esecuzione e monitoraggio delle commesse e dei servizi offerti.

REQUISITI

- Laurea triennale o magistrale in discipline tecnico-scientifiche o economiche.

- Conoscenza del SO Windows e del Pacchetto Office.

- Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.

- Interesse per i temi GIS, BIM, Digital Twin e infrastrutture digitali.

- Conoscenza di base dei principi di project management.

- Capacità di redazione di documentazione tecnica e reportistica.

- Costituisce titolo preferenziale la conoscenza di piattaforme GIS (Esri, QGIS) e/o BIM (Autodesk, ACC, Civil 3D, Revit, InfraWorks o analoghe).

Soft skills

- Orientamento all’organizzazione e alla pianificazione.

- Ottime capacità relazionali e comunicative.

- Interesse per gli aspetti di business development e customer success.

COSA OFFRIAMO

- Percorso di crescita professionale in un settore in forte espansione.

- Affiancamento diretto con professionisti senior del settore GIS e BIM.

- Coinvolgimento in progetti innovativi e strategici.

- Ambiente dinamico, orientato all’innovazione e alla valorizzazione delle competenze.

- Opportunità di sviluppare competenze sia tecniche sia manageriali e commerciali.

INQUADRAMENTO

- CCNL Commercio, Terziario, Servizi

- Range retributivo: 24.000 – 27.500

- Welfare aziendale secondo regolamento interno

- Smart working

- Dotazione aziendale standard

- Piano formativo e di crescita

Se sei in linea con la posizione, invia il tuo CV all’indirizzo risorseumane@oneteam.it.

jobs.title: A220 Maintenance program Manager / Responsable du programme de maintenance Airbus A220
jobs.description: Job Description:   A220 Maintenance program Manager / Responsable du programme de maintenance Airbus A220   ***English job description follows***  Description de l'emploi : Possédez-vous une solide expérience dans l'industrie aérospatiale, plus particulièrement dans le développement de programmes de maintenance ? Avez-vous travaillé sur différents chapitres et sections ATA et/ou sur des aéronefs, et souhaitez-vous progresser et développer de nouvelles compétences ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !  Le programme d'avions commerciaux A220 est à la recherche d'un(e) responsable de programme de maintenance pour rejoindre notre équipe de gestion des programmes de maintenance basée à Mirabel (Québec, Canada). Vous y travaillerez conjointement avec diverses équipes d'Airbus telles que, sans s'y limiter, l'équipe d'ingénierie des structures de la cellule et de conception des systèmes, l'équipe d'ingénierie des réparations en service, l'équipe du bureau du programme A220, ainsi que les équipes de navigabilité, de fiabilité et de sécurité.  Vous ferez partie de l'équipe de gestion des programmes de maintenance et relèverez directement du Chef de la gestion des programmes de maintenance. Vous serez responsable de l'élaboration d'un programme de maintenance cohérent et rentable pour les nouvelles conceptions de structures de cellule et/ou de systèmes, ou pour l'amélioration de ces dernières, sur le programme d'avions commerciaux A220. L'organisation de l'équipe est établie pour promouvoir la collaboration transversale de manière autonome, le soutien mutuel et l'apprentissage collectif.  Votre rôle stratégique en tant que responsable de programme de maintenance sera d'assurer l'optimisation et la livraison des programmes de maintenance pour nos appareils actuels, tout en jouant un rôle clé dans le développement des programmes pour les futurs appareils. Vous serez au cœur de la synchronisation de la documentation de la maintenance programmée et de son amélioration continue. Vous serez également un acteur majeur dans la définition des principes fondamentaux des futurs programmes de maintenance, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec diverses parties prenantes internes et externes.  Votre environnement de travail: Le siège du programme d'avions commerciaux A220 est situé à Mirabel, dans la région métropolitaine de Montréal, à deux pas de la ville dynamique de Montréal. Réputée pour son environnement paisible et sûr, la région offre une grande qualité de vie aux jeunes professionnels ou aux professionnels expérimentés, ainsi qu'aux familles, en équilibrant parfaitement les opportunités de carrière et les activités de plein air, ce qui en fait un endroit vraiment spécial où il fait bon vivre.  Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : Avantages financiers: Salaire attractif, bonus annuel, régime d’assurances collectives, régime de retraite et régime d’achat d’actions.  Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle: Une politique de travail hybride, une cafétéria sur site, une politique de congés très concurrentielle.  Bien-être / santé: Programme d’Aide aux Employé.e.s (PAE), programme de rabais, service médical sur site, service de navette publique entre Montréal et Mirabel et application de covoiturage.  Développement individuel: des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, mobilité nationale et internationale).  Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation.  Vos défis:  Co-présider le comité de pilotage de l'industrie (ISC) de l'A220   Définir, planifier, préparer et coordonner le forum ISC avec les exploitants, les fournisseurs, les autorités de navigabilité, l'équipe de gestion du programme de maintenance d'Airbus et les autres départements d'Airbus,   Contrôler le flux et le niveau des discussions sur tout sujet donné pendant le forum ISC.   Préparer la proposition de rapport du comité d'examen de la maintenance (MRBR) pour soumission aux autorités de navigabilité,   Organiser la familiarisation avec les aéronefs et la formation procédurale d'analyse MSG-3 pour tous les groupes de travail sur la maintenance (MWG) et l'ISC.   Assurer une communication efficace et efficiente entre le MWG, l'ISC et le comité d'examen de la maintenance (MRB).   Suivre l'alignement des activités des groupes de travail sur la maintenance (MWG) avec les décisions de l'ISC en coordination avec les coprésidents du MWG.   Assurer une communication régulière avec les présidents du MRB (autorités de navigabilité) pour garantir le succès des forums MWG et ISC.   Organiser, préparer et coordonner les examens périodiques avec les présidents du MRB.   Coordonner avec les experts en ingénierie de maintenance pour identifier, préparer et présenter au forum ISC toute mise à jour des politiques, réglementations et procédures du programme de maintenance dans le manuel de politiques et de procédures (PPH) ainsi que les impacts sur le programme de maintenance.   Assurer la synchronisation, la cohérence et l'exhaustivité des Instructions pour le maintien de la navigabilité (ICA) de l'ingénierie de maintenance : MRBR - AWL- CMP -MPD, y compris l'ensemble complet des procédures de maintenance (AMP et NDT).   Soutenir la gestion des risques et les actions d'atténuation de l'exhaustivité des ICA.   Superviser la surveillance continue des changements de conception (y compris le développement futur du programme), de l'impact des problèmes en service et de l'impact des nouvelles technologies/réglementations/politiques sur les ICA de l'ingénierie de maintenance pour assurer leur mise à jour et leur amélioration constantes.   Veiller à ce que les livrables soient produits à temps et conformément aux directives.   Suivre le respect des processus du programme de maintenance avec le soutien du Chef du programme de maintenance.   Soutenir la préparation du MWG (par exemple, les essais à blanc) à la demande des coprésidents du MWG ou du Chef de programme de maintenance.   Participer et soutenir toute réunion avec les clients de l'A220 en relation avec les sujets du programme de maintenance.   Assister aux réunions MPM d'Airbus avec tous les autres responsables de programme de maintenance (MPM) des programmes hérités d'Airbus pour assurer la cohérence entre tous les programmes Airbus.   Contribuer au service facturable lié à la maintenance programmée (par exemple, préparation du package de remise à zéro de l'horloge et soutien à la déclaration de remise à zéro de l'horloge).  Votre profil:  Diplômé d’un Baccalauréat en génie mécanique ou aérospatial.   Minimum de 10 ans d'expérience pertinente en maintenance d’aviation commerciale en opérations aériennes/MRO et dans l'environnement de la maintenance.   Solides connaissances en structure et systèmes aéronautiques (expérience de travail sur différents chapitres et sections ATA sur avions commerciaux).   Solides compétences et état d'esprit en gestion de projet - Une certification en gestion de projet est un atout.   Très axé sur le client, apprend rapidement, adaptable et esprit d'équipe.   Excellentes compétences en présentation et attitude professionnelle.   Solides compétences en coordination et en relations interpersonnelles pour interagir avec les clients, les partenaires, les autorités de navigabilité et les autres départements d'Airbus.   Excellentes compétences en négociation.   Expérience de travail dans un environnement transnational.   Bonne connaissance générale des concepts d'ingénierie de maintenance, y compris les systèmes, la propulsion, la structure, les zones, l'EWIS et le L/HIRF, ainsi que la réglementation sur la navigabilité continue applicable aux aéronefs civils modernes.   Maîtrise des outils Google standard obligatoires pour le poste. À l'aise avec les solutions numériques.   Compétences linguistiques minimales : niveau de négociation en anglais, niveau débutant en français.  Comme ce poste nécessite des voyages d'affaires réguliers, vous devez être disponible et disposé à remplir ces engagements de déplacement.  Ce travail nécessite une prise de conscience liée à tous les risques potentiels de conformité et à un engagement à agir avec intégrité, ces valeurs sont le fondement du succès, de la réputation et de la croissance durable de l'entreprise.  Vous ne semblez pas correspondre à 100%? Pas d'inquiétude! Airbus vous accompagnera pour trouver le poste qui correspond le mieux à vos compétences et aspirations.  Donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière en soumettant votre candidature en ligne maintenant !   *************************************  Job description : Do you have a sound experience in the aerospace industry in maintenance program development, have you worked on different ATA chapters & sections and/or on aircraft and would you like to progress and develop new skills? Then this job is for you!  The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is looking for a Maintenance Program Manager to join our Maintenance program management team based in Mirabel (Québec, Canada), where you will work jointly with various Airbus teams such as but not limited to the Airframe structure & System Design engineering team, the In-Service repair engineering team, The A220 program office team and the Airworthiness, reliability & safety teams.  You will be part of the Maintenance program management team, directly reporting to the head of maintenance program management. You will be responsible for developing a consistent and cost effective maintenance program of new airframe structure and/or System designs or improvements of the latter on the A220 commercial aircraft Programme.   The team organization is established to promote cross-collaboration autonomously, supporting each other and learning collectively.  Your strategic role as Maintenance program manager will be to ensure the optimization and delivery of maintenance programs for our current aircraft, while also playing a key part in the development of programs for future aircraft. You will be at the heart of synchronizing scheduled maintenance documentation and its continuous improvement. You will also be a major player in defining the fundamental principles of future maintenance programs, working closely with various internal and external stakeholders.  Your working environment: The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is headquartered in Mirabel, in the greater Montreal area, where the vibrant city of Montreal is just a stone’s throw away. Known for its peaceful and safe environment, the region offers a high quality of life for younger or experienced professionals and families, perfectly balancing career opportunities and outdoor activities that makes it a truly special place to call home.  How we care for you: Financial rewards: Attractive salary, annual bonus, group insurance plan, pension plan and share purchase plan.  Work / Life Balance: A hybrid working policy, on-site cafeterias and a highly competitive holiday policy.  Wellbeing/Health: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Discount Program, on-site Medical Service, public shuttle service between Montreal and Mirabel and carpooling application.  Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility.  Your challenges:   Co-Chairing the A220 Industry Steering Committee (ISC)   Defining, Scheduling, preparing and coordinating the ISC forum with operators, suppliers, airworthiness authorities, Airbus Maintenance program management team and the other Airbus departments,   Controlling the flow and level of discussions on any given topic during the ISC forum.   Preparing the Maintenance Review Board Report (MRBR) Proposal for submission to the Airworthiness authorities,   Arranging aircraft familiarization and MSG-3 analysis procedural training for all Maintenance working groups (MWG) and the ISC.   Ensuring an effective and efficient communication between the MWG, the ISC and the Maintenance Review Board (MRB).   Monitoring the Maintenance Working Group (MWG) activities are aligned with the ISC decisions in coordination with the MWG co-chairpersons.   Ensuring regular communication with the MRB chairpersons (airworthiness Authorities) to secure the success of the MWG and ISC forums.   Arranging, preparing and coordinating the periodic reviews with the MRB chairpersons.   Coordinating with Maintenance engineering Experts to identify, prepare and present at the ISC forum any maintenance program policies, regulations and procedures updates in the policy and procedure handbook (PPH) as well as the maintenance program impacts.   Ensuring the synchronization, the consistency and completeness of the maintenance engineering Instructions for Continued Airworthiness (ICAs): MRBR - AWL- CMP -MPD including the complete set of Maintenance procedures (AMP and NDT).   Supporting the risk management and mitigation actions of ICA completeness.   Overseeing the continuous monitoring of the design change (including future program development), In-service issues impact and new technologies/regulations/policies impacts on the maintenance engineering ICAs to ensure their constant update and improvement.   Ensuring that the deliverables are produced on time and in accordance with guidelines.   Monitoring adherence to the maintenance program processes with the support of the Head of Maintenance program management.   Supporting the MWG preparation (e.g. Dry runs) upon request of the MWG co-chairpersons or Head of Maintenance program management.   Participating and Supporting any meeting with A220 customers in relation with Maintenance program topics.   Attending the Airbus MPM meetings with all the other Airbus legacy program Maintenance Program Managers (MPM) to ensure consistency across all Airbus programs.,   Contributing to the chargeable service related to scheduled maintenance (E.g. Clock Reset Package preparation and Clock reset Statement support).  Your boarding pass:  Graduated with an engineering degree in mechanical or Aerospace.   Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in commercial aircraft maintenance, airline/MRO operations, and the maintenance environment.   Sound knowledge in the aircraft structure & systems (work experience on different ATA chapters & sections on commercial aircraft).   Strong project management skills and mindset - PM Certification is a plus.   Highly customer-focused, quick learner, adaptative and Team player   Excellent presentation skills and professional demeanor.   Strong coordination and interpersonal skills to interact with customers, partners, airworthiness authorities, and other Airbus departments.   Excellent negotiation skills.   Experience working in a transnational environment.   Good general knowledge in the maintenance engineering concepts including System, powerplant, structure, zonal, EWIS and L/HIRF and the continuous airworthiness regulation applicable to modern civil aircraft.   Proficiency in standard Google suite tools mandatory for the job. Comfortable with digital solutions.   Minimum Language skills: negotiation level of english, beginner level of french.  As this position requires regular business trips, you must be available and willing to fulfill these travel commitments. Bien-être / santé: Programme d’Aide aux Employé.e.s (PAE), programme de rabais, service médical sur site, service de navette entre Montréal et Mirabel et application de covoiturage.  Développement individuel:  des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, mobilité nationale et internationale).   Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation.  Vos défis:  Développer, optimiser et mettre à jour les tâches de maintenance planifiée recommandées des Structure et Zones avions, EWIS et L/HIRF de l’A220 dont vous aurez la charge, en utilisant la méthodologie MSG-3, dans le but de garantir un programme de maintenance avion efficace d’un point de vue sécurité avion, disponibilité et économique.   Identifier et prendre toute initiative nécessaire afin d’optimiser les tâches de maintenance planifiée obligatoire issues du processus de certification de type (limitations de navigabilité).   S’approprier et évaluer toute nouvelle conception ou amélioration de conception de l’A220 dans le but d’influencer toute modification de conception et/ou ajustement de calendrier d’incorporation qui seraient potentiellement requis pour cibler la mise en œuvre d’un programme de maintenance efficace.   Prendre en compte l'ensemble des problèmes en service de la flotte A220 ainsi que les retours d’expérience clients afin d’améliorer le programme de maintenance de l’A220 et permettre ainsi une amélioration de la performance opérationnelle et de la satisfaction clients.   Travailler en collaboration avec vos collègues au sein d’une équipe composée de 6 personnes pour conjointement déterminer le périmètre des activités, puis définir, coordonner et mener à bien le plan pour achever toutes les activités requises dans les délais impartis tout en fournissant une visibilité à votre gestionnaire.   Développer, vérifier et approuver toutes les procédures de tâches de maintenance planifiée sous votre responsabilité au travers de vérification “sur papier” et validation sur avion.   identifier, développer et mettre en œuvre, sur votre initiative, tout processus et projets indépendants pour améliorer l’efficacité du développement du programme de maintenance A220.   Préparer , présenter et soutenir avec force et engagement l'approbation de toutes mises à jour du programme de maintenance structure, zonal, EWIS et L/HIRF dont vous êtes en charge devant les clients de l’A220 (compagnies aériennes) et les autorités de l’aviation civile.  Votre profil:  Diplômé d’un Baccalauréat en génie mécanique ou aérospatial.   Minimum 5 ans d’expérience professionnelle de préférence dans une compagnie aérienne ou MRO en ingénierie de conception structure avion ou d’ingénierie de maintenance structure avion.   Expertise dans plusieurs des chapitres ATA suivants: 32, 52, 53, 54, 55.   Bonne connaissance générale des concepts d’ingénierie de maintenance incluant structure, zonal, EWIS et L/HIRF ainsi que de la réglementation du maintien de navigabilité applicable aux avions civils modernes.   Qualité de leader et compétences en gestion de projet.   Orienté client, apprend vite, grande faculté d’adaptation et excellente compétence de présentation.   La maîtrise complète des outils de la suite Google est obligatoire pour cette position. Être globalement à l’aise avec les outils informatiques et solutions digitales.   Compétences linguistiques minimales: Niveau avancé en anglais, débutant en français.   Ce travail nécessite une prise de conscience liée à tous les risques potentiels de conformité et à un engagement à agir avec intégrité, ces valeurs sont le fondement du succès, de la réputation et de la croissance durable de l'entreprise.   Vous ne semblez pas correspondre à 100%? Pas d'inquiétude! Airbus vous accompagnera pour trouver le poste qui correspond le mieux à vos compétences et aspirations.   Donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière en soumettant votre candidature en ligne maintenant !   *************************************  Job description :  Do you have experience in the aerospace industry , have you worked in airframe structure design engineering and/or airframe structure maintenance engineering and would you like to progress and develop new skills? Then this job is for you!   The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is looking for an structure maintenance program analyst (f/m) to join our Maintenance engineering team based in Mirabel (Québec, Canada), where you will work jointly with various Airbus teams such as but not limited to the Airframe structure Design engineering team, the In-Service repair engineering team, The A220 program office team and the Airworthiness, reliability & safety teams.   You will be part of the Maintenance program management team responsible for developing a consistent and cost effective maintenance program of new airframe structure designs or improvements of the latter on the A220 commercial aircraft Programme.   The team organization is established to promote cross-collaboration autonomously, supporting each other and learning collectively.   Your role as structure maintenance program analyst will be to d evelop, monitor, challenge and improve all the scheduled maintenance requirements of the aircraft structure, zonal, Electrical wiring interconnection system (EWIS) as well as lightning and high intensity radiated field (L/HIRF) protection devices you will be accountable for. To do so, you will have to primarily apply a holistic and top-down analysis approach on significant structural items and aircraft zones based on reliability centered maintenance methodology (MSG-3) and in-service experience in accordance with the continuous airworthiness regulation.  Your working environment:  The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is headquartered in Mirabel, in the greater Montreal area, where the vibrant city of Montreal is just a stone’s throw away. Known for its peaceful and safe environment, the region offers a high quality of life for younger or experienced professionals and families, perfectly balancing career opportunities and outdoor activities that makes it a truly special place to call home.  How we care for you: Financial rewards:  Attractive salary, annual bonus, group insurance plan, pension plan and share purchase plan.  Work / Life Balance:  A hybrid working policy, on-site cafeterias and a highly competitive holiday policy.  Wellbeing/Health: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Discount Program, on-site Medical Service, shuttle service between Montreal and Mirabel and carpooling application.  Individual development:  Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility.  Your challenges:   Develop, optimize and update the recommended scheduled maintenance tasks based on MSG-3 methodology for the A220 airframe structures, zones, EWIS and L/HIRF you are accountable for, in order to guarantee an efficient aircraft maintenance program from safety, availability and economic perspectives.   Identify and lead initiatives to optimize the mandatory scheduled maintenance tasks derived from the type certification process (Airworthiness limitations).   Take ownership and assess any A220 design development or improvement to influence any potential design modifications and/or incorporation schedule adjustment to target an efficient maintenance program implementation.   Consider all the A220 fleet in-service issues and feedback from our customers to improve the A220 maintenance program and enable an increased operational performance and customer satisfaction.   Coordinate with a team of 6 people to jointly identify the scope of work, then define, coordinate and drive the plan to complete all required activities on due time and provide visibility to your management.   Develop, review and approve all scheduled maintenance tasks under your responsibility through “paper” validation and on-aircraft validation.   Identify, develop and implement, on your own initiative, any processes and standalone projects to make the A220 maintenance program development more effective   Prepare, present and strongly support all Structure, Zonal, EWIS and L/HIRF Maintenance program updates you are accountable for in front of A220 customers (airlines) and Civil aviation Authorities for approval.  Your boarding pass:  Graduated with a Bachelor of engineering degree in Mechanical or Aerospace.   Minimum of 5 years of professional experience preferably with Airlines or MRO in Airframe structure design engineering or Airframe structure maintenance engineering.   Expertise on some of the following ATA chapters: 32, 52, 53, 54, 55.   Good general knowledge in the maintenance engineering concepts including structure, zonal, EWIS and L/HIRF and the continuous airworthiness regulation applicable to modern civil aircraft.   Leadership and project management skills.   Customer focus, quick learner, adaptative and Excellent presentation skills.   Proficiency in standard Google suite tools mandatory for the job. Comfortable with digital solutions.   Minimum Language skills: advanced level of english, beginner level of french.   This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.   Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.   Take your career to a new level and apply online now! jobs.description:

jobs.title: Design & Utilization - Sr Project Manager Capacity & Yield Management
jobs.description:
bpost strives to create an inclusive environment with challenging projects and inspiring collaborations. With our colleagues at the heart of our organisation, we believe in careers rather than jobs. As part of the international group bnode, bpost has transitioned from the Belgian postal operator to a regional and digital expert in parcel size logistics. With a focus on social and environmental sustainability, our people are the foundation of everything we do. We foster a culture that supports diversity, inclusion and career growth, ensuring that every team member has the opportunity to thrive and succeedWhat will you do?

At Bnode, we believe careers are built through stimulating challenges, inspiring collaborations, and continuous development. Our Out-of-Home network lockers and pickup points used daily by thousands of customers lies at the heart of our logistics innovation.

To support the next phase of our capacity & yield management strategy, we are looking for a Senior Project Manager Capacity / Yield who can operate at the intersection of data, strategy, and execution.

As Senior Project Manager Capacity, you will maximize the profitability and utilization of OOH assets (lockers & parcel points) by transforming analytical insights into end-to-end strategic projects.

Your role sits at the intersection of revenue optimization, capacity planning, and strategic project management.

Your Responsibilities

Strategic Project Management

- Lead complex projects related to OOH network capacity and profitability, from initial scoping through implementation.

- Structure business problems, define priorities, and establish a clear roadmap for each initiative.

- Coordinate multiple stakeholders and ensure alignment between operations, commercial, and finance teams.

- Ensure effective project follow-up, respect of timelines, and achievement of defined objectives.

Capacity & Revenue Optimization

- Develop and implement strategies to optimize the utilization of lockers and parcel pickup points.

- Analyze revenue and margin structures to identify opportunities to improve financial performance.

- Contribute to capacity allocation decisions in order to maximize asset profitability.

- Assess the financial impact of strategic options and support capacity investment decisions.

Capacity Planning & Management

- Develop capacity planning models aligned with commercial and financial objectives.

- Anticipate demand evolution and adjust capacity strategies accordingly.

- Identify capacity constraints and propose solutions to improve operational and economic efficiency.

- Continuously monitor network utilization and performance.

Data-Driven Analysis & Decision Making

- Conduct in-depth analysis of network utilization and channel performance.

- Translate analytical insights into clear and actionable strategic recommendations.

- Develop and maintain reporting to monitor capacity usage, revenue performance, and margins.

- Contribute to improving the analytical tools and methodologies used within the team.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Stakeholder Management

- Work closely with Capacity, Operations, Commercial, Finance, and Data teams.

- Support decision-making by bringing a structured and business-oriented perspective.

- Ensure clear and effective communication across different levels of the organization.

- Support the implementation of strategic initiatives and alignment of teams around shared objectives.

Who are you?

- Master’s degree in Economics, Logistics, Data Science, or a related field

- 5+ years of experience in strategy, revenue management, or capacity management

- Strong problem-structuring and analytical skills

- Ability to lead complex projects end-to-end

- Experience in revenue optimization and profitability analysis

- Advanced Excel skills

- Experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent)

- Knowledge of capacity planning and demand forecasting techniques

- Affinity with pricing and yield management strategies

- Strong ownership mindset and sense of responsibility

- Ability to structure and defend well-reasoned arguments

- Comfortable coordinating multiple stakeholders

- Ability to thrive in dynamic and demanding environments

- Excellent communication skills

- Languages: Dutch, French, and English

What do we offer?

Like a Long-awaited Parcel, We Want To Make You Feel Welcome And Valued. Our Offer Includes a Competitive Monthly Salary, That Goes Without Saying. On Top Of That, You Can Count On

- Meal vouchers of €8 per working day

- Hospitalization-, group- and disability insurances

- A phone subscription, including 25GB data

- A flexible renumeration plan, which allows you to customize your own benefits. A company car, bike leasing, public transportation, extra days off,... the choice is yours

- Possibility to enter the Federal Mobility plan

- Work/life balance, thanks to flexible working hours and the possibility to work from home

- 20 days of statutory leave and 7 additional extralegal days off

- An end-of-year and performance-based bonus and double holiday pay

- Many benefits from more than 100 bpost-partners

Mercury is an equal opportunity employer

Chef de projet CSA, Mons

Nos solutions contribuent à diffuser des technologies et des avancées qui transforment des vies, connectant les personnes, les communautés et les entreprises et leur donnant les moyens de réaliser des choses incroyables. Notre peuple a le courage d'innover. Leur détermination et leur concentration sans faille nous permettent de tenir nos promesses avec certitude, à chaque fois.

Nous concrétisons les visions de nos clients grâce à des solutions de construction de pointe dans de multiples secteurs, notamment : les centres de données d'entreprise, les technologies avancées et les sciences de la vie, les centres de données hyperscale et la protection contre l'incendie.

Chez Mercury, notre devoir est d'encourager et de soutenir nos collaborateurs afin qu'ils réalisent leur potentiel. Nous les plaçons au cœur de nos activités, en leur offrant des opportunités stimulantes de se développer au sein d'une équipe formidable, dans un environnement favorable qui leur permette d'atteindre leur plein potentiel.

Principales Responsabilités Du Poste

- Assurer la liaison avec les principales parties prenantes afin de mener à bien tous les aspects des projets assignés.

- Élaborer des stratégies d'exécution de projet.

- Élaborer des plans logistiques de site (démobilisation / mobilisation).

- Élaborer et mettre en œuvre les calendriers de projet en fonction des étapes clés, en coordination avec tous les corps de métier et les travaux de CSA.

- Élaborer et mettre en œuvre les plans de coûts et de budget du projet.

- Examiner, approuver et mettre en œuvre les plans et procédures qualité du projet.

- Examiner, approuver et mettre en œuvre le plan de gestion EHS du projet.

- Gestion et motivation des équipes de construction et d'ingénierie du projet.

- Élaborer et suivre les calendriers d'approvisionnement en matériel conformément aux exigences du calendrier.

- Sélectionner et désigner les sous-traitants et la chaîne d'approvisionnement du projet en collaboration avec les équipes de projet et conformément aux spécifications.

- Animer les réunions hebdomadaires internes avec l'équipe, les fournisseurs et les sous-traitants afin de coordonner et de garantir la performance du projet.

- Superviser le contrôle des coûts et des revenus du projet, rendre compte des performances et publier des rapports hebdomadaires à ce sujet.

- Participation aux réunions de gestion de projet/clients.
